sections.heading: Treatment for Urbandale, from our Johnston campus
body: Our Johnston campus sits just north of Urbandale, close enough that many clients keep the same commute they already know. That proximity matters more than it sounds: it means family can attend evening therapy sessions without a long drive, and it means stepping down from residential care into outpatient does not require moving your life around.

Urbandale residents most often come to us for alcohol and prescription-medication treatment, frequently alongside anxiety or depression that has gone unaddressed for years. We treat both together rather than in sequence.

sections.heading: Getting here from Urbandale
body: We are at 5820 Winwood Dr, Johnston, IA 50131 — about 10 minutes from Urbandale, with easy access from I-35, I-80 and I-235. Familiar landmarks nearby include Hyperion Field Club, Walker Johnston Park and the Urbandale Public Library.

sections.heading: Start treatment near Urbandale today
body: Admissions specialists are available 24/7. Calls are free, confidential, and carry no obligation to enrol.
